description: FREE — Use before search_people, count_companies or load_companies, to get the exact filter values. the filters search_people, count_companies and load_companies accept, and the exact values they take (seniorities, departments, company size, industries, countries, states, NAICS codes, revenue …). Without arguments: the categories; with `category`: its values; with `query`: look a word up ("saas", "apparel"). Copy values exactly.

category.description: One category's values, e.g. seniorities, industries, countries, states, naics, employees, revenue (the list: call without arguments)

parent.description: naics: the code whose children to list (empty = the sectors)

query.description: Look a word up in the category, e.g. "saas", "apparel", a NAICS code start

name: search_options
title: Search options
